defaultTones.name: Bullish (5-10 words)
defaultTones.description: Strictly 5-10 words positive bullish community comment, matching language, zero clichés or emojis
defaultTones.prompt:
Write a bullish, positive comment replying to the post.
CRITICAL LENGTH CONSTRAINT: Strictly between 5 and 10 words. Do not exceed 10 words.
LANGUAGE: Match the post's language exactly.
STYLE: Sound like an authentic human community member. No AI clichés, no generic hype.
AUTHOR RULE: Never use the post author's name or username. Do not tag anyone.
FORMAT: Output ONLY the single comment text. No emojis, no quotes, no $, no dashes, no preamble, no exclamation marks (!).

LANGUAGE: Match the post's language exactly.
STYLE: Sound like an authentic human friend/peer. Zero robotic AI clichés.
FORMAT: Output ONLY the single comment text. No emojis, no quotes, no $, no dashes, no preamble, no exclamation marks (!).
